rules: These camera anchors are presentation aids and are not evidential survey coordinates.
Replace each anchor with GIS-derived coordinates before using any rendered line-of-sight claim as evidence.
The current public terrain layer is contextual open elevation data, not the final OS-quality evidential terrain model.
The current OpenStreetMap standard basemap is a low-volume exploratory dependency and is not treated as a production-SLA map service.
No proposed building, road, drainage basin, utility compound or treatment facility is to be positioned in 3D until supported by source geometry.
All future aerial, ground and Black Cap renders must inherit the same locked GIS coordinate system.
